profile.headline: Lead Principal Software Engineer | ServiceNow Platform Lead
profile.summary:
I'm a ServiceNow engineering leader with 10+ years of progressive experience designing, delivering, and supporting enterprise platform solutions across healthcare, higher education, and financial services.

As a Lead Principal Software Engineer at University of Utah Health, I provide technical leadership and strategic direction for ServiceNow initiatives supporting both the health system and the broader university. My responsibilities include guiding architectural decisions, establishing engineering standards, and leading development teams in delivering scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

My expertise spans platform architecture, complex workflow automation, enterprise integrations, Agile delivery, and platform optimization. I'm particularly passionate about improving platform health, reducing technical debt, and building sustainable solutions that balance business needs with long-term technical strategy.

Beyond the technology, I enjoy mentoring developers, strengthening engineering practices, and fostering an environment where teams collaborate, take ownership, and consistently deliver quality work.

positions.title: Lead Principal Software Engineer | ServiceNow Platform Lead
positions.description:
Provide engineering leadership and technical direction for enterprise ServiceNow initiatives supporting University of Utah Health and the broader University of Utah campus.

- Lead and mentor ServiceNow development teams, providing technical guidance, architectural oversight, and engineering accountability.
- Guide the design, development, and implementation of complex enterprise solutions, workflows, integrations, and automations.
- Collaborate with management and organizational leadership to align technical initiatives with strategic business objectives.
- Establish and promote engineering standards, development best practices, and consistent technical approaches across teams.
- Oversee platform performance, reliability, upgrades, and technical improvements across development and production environments.
- Drive technical problem-solving, cross-team collaboration, and continuous improvement while supporting multiple concurrent initiatives.
positions.insights: Leading Development Teams, Technology Leadership and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer III | Technical Lead, Scrum Master, ServiceNow Engineer
positions.description:
- Act as technical lead for ServiceNow initiatives supporting clinical and operational teams across the organization
- Own end-to-end delivery of critical ServiceNow capabilities, from technical design through deployment and operational support
- Drive design and implementation of complex workflows, integrations, and automations within the ServiceNow platform
- Make independent technical decisions and architectural tradeoffs aligned with long-term platform strategy
- Influence architectural decisions and development standards to improve consistency, maintainability, and delivery quality across teams
- Ensure platform reliability, security, and compliance by proactively identifying risks and implementing sustainable technical solutions
- Partner directly with stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable, supportable technical solutions
- Serve as Scrum Master, facilitating sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery accountability
- Mentor developers and provide technical guidance across teams to raise overall delivery quality

Interim Team Leadership (Manager Vacancy)
- Assumed day-to-day team leadership responsibilities during management vacancy, including workload prioritization, delivery coordination, and stakeholder communication
- Acted as the primary escalation point for technical and delivery decisions
- Maintained sprint execution, delivery commitments, and overall team stability throughout the transition period
- Acted as proxy for the manager in meetings, representing the team’s priorities and delivery status
- Represented the team in cross-functional and leadership forums during the vacancy
